text:
Maya R: kicking off a canary for FP8 kernel enablement across H100/L40S for atlas-13b. split by hw=H100/L40S, seq buckets: short/long. noticing a warmup token quality delta only on L40S long-prefix requests (~0.6% ppl increase). opening thread for triage.

bench-bot: canary snapshot: h100: ppl delta 0.02%, lat 23ms; l40s: ppl delta 0.6%, lat 31ms; sample diff (long prefix): "The model now outputs '...' instead of '...' ."

Liam K: @Maya R any easy repro? batch size, typical seq len, flags?

Maya R: repro steps below. small shadow run shows same delta. config we used:
```
MODEL=atlas-13b
FP8_KERNEL=enabled
HW_SPLIT=[H100,L40S]
BATCH_POLICY=continuous
SEQ_BUCKETS=short:32,long:2048
CANARY_PCT=10
```
run: `./run_canary.sh --split l40s --seq 2048 --batch 1`

Sanjeev P: suspect kv-cache warmup on L40S quant path. AWQ/GPTQ fallback might be triggering different kv init path. did logs show any kv errors?

Maya R: logs show repeated warnings during early tokens: `kv_cache_init: mismatch expected_len=0 got=16` and `warmup_prefix_shadowed=true` around request start. attaching excerpt: 
```
[2025-11-02T14:02:03Z] kv_cache_init: node=atlas-l40s-07 expected_len=0 got=16
[2025-11-02T14:02:03Z] fp8_quant: using awq_fallback=false kernel=v2
[2025-11-02T14:02:04Z] perf: first_tokens_slow 12ms
```
Ari N: could be ordering when kv is reused across micro-batches. try forcing per-request kv-reset for L40S and re-run. also compare with forcing `AWQ_OVERRIDE=true` to force AWQ quant path on H100 to see if behavior follows quantization not hw.

bench-bot: quick delta after forcing per-request kv reset on L40S: ppl delta drops to 0.15%, lat +3ms. forcing AWQ_OVERRIDE on H100 shows 0.18% ppl delta (so quant path likely contributor).

Liam K: actionable plan: 1) pause L40S canary if ppl delta >0.5% 2) run narrow A/B: (a) L40S + kv-reset, (b) L40S + AWQ_override, (c) H100 + AWQ_override. 3) collect token-level divergence trace and small prompt set.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout updated: l40s group -> paused by @Liam K at 3355554480 :pause_button:

ops-team: saw a small spike in controller CPU when the L40S nodes started warmup traffic. might be related to per-request kv resets if we enable them widely.

Maya R: i'll run the A/B now with a 200-prompt curated set (long prefixes, multi-turn). will post traces. planning to try the `KV_WARMUP_FIX` toggle first: `export REDWOOD_FP8_KV_WARMUP=reset_per_request` then re-run.

Sanjeev P: also add a check for quant-ops ordering in the runtime logs: grep for `quant_op_order` and `kv_attach` timestamps. if quant ops move before kv attach we can reproduce deterministically.

Maya R: quick note: when I forced `AWQ_OVERRIDE=true` on L40S, ppl delta dropped to 0.12% but latency increased ~6ms. suggests a tactical fallback: prefer AWQ for long-prefix L40S until kernel fix.

Ari N: agree. long-term we need kernel handshake fix to ensure kv init happens deterministically across mixed-precision codegen paths. short-term mitigations: 1) per-request kv-reset (costly), 2) AWQ fallback for long-seq on L40S (cost and latency tradeoff), 3) split route by seq length.

Maya R: posting minimal repro script in case someone wants to run locally:
```bash
# repro: long-prefix drift
./canary_runner --model atlas-13b --hw l40s --seq 2048 --batch 1 --prompts longset.txt --fp8-kernel on --awq-override false
```

Liam K: canary paused, please keep updates here. if we can get a deterministic trace Sam/Eval team can run offline for quality regression gating. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: saved traces to s3://redwood-canary/3355554321/traces.tar.gz

Maya R: uploaded kv/timestamps trace and token-diff CSV to that bucket. will start the AWQ-vs-kernel micro-A/B now and report numbers in ~30m.

Sanjeev P: thanks — if AWQ fallback reduces reg but latency is acceptable we should hotfix routing policy to avoid user-visible regressions.

Maya R: update 30m: AWQ fallback on L40S -> ppl delta 0.10%, lat +6ms. KV reset -> ppl delta 0.13%, lat +3ms but higher controller CPU. proposing short-term: route long-seq L40S -> AWQ, short-seq can stay fp8 kernel.

Liam K: sounds good. please open a PR for routing change + an ops runbook for controller CPU monitoring on KV reset.

Maya R: will do. thanks everyone.
